**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939),
[Miss Sewell](../persons.html#1301) is in want of a volume of Milmans Latin Christianity which the [London Library](../others.html#29) does not send.

She will write to you which it is and perhaps you could kindly cause it to be sent to her. I cant think what [Clay](../others.html#173) meant by our delaying the [proofs](../books.html#71) for we had never done so.
I have never had any of [Heartsease](../books.html#19) to put the headings to the pages.[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: This issue, and the reference to Clay’s complaint, must have been raised by Macmillan in letters either missing from the archive, or indecipherable because of bad wet-press copying.
